accident: Get medical help first. Call 112 if anyone is hurt.
Take photos of the vehicle, the place and any injuries.
Tell the platform's support in the app within 24 hours and ask about accident insurance.
If there is damage or injury, file a police report and keep the copy.
Tell your insurer and keep all bills.
harassment: Move to a safe, public place. Call 112 if you are in danger.
Write down the time, place and what was said or done.
Report it to the platform's support in the app.
You can file a police complaint. Keep the acknowledgement copy.
theft: Note what was stolen and when.
File a police complaint (FIR or e-FIR) and keep the copy.
If your phone was stolen, block the SIM and report the IMEI on the CEIR portal.
Tell the platform if work items or cash were taken.
unsafe-area: Leave the place if you can and stay where there are people and lights.
Tell a family member where you are.
Report the location to the platform so they can warn others.
payment-dispute: Note the order or trip IDs and the amounts.
Ask platform support in writing for the reason.
If there is no answer in 7 days, write to the grievance officer or your labour department.
deactivation: Ask the platform in writing for the reason and how to appeal.
Save screenshots of your ratings, earnings and any messages.
In Karnataka and Rajasthan, you can also go to the gig worker welfare board.
other: Write down what happened while you remember it.
Save any photos or messages as proof.
Raise a complaint with the right office if needed.

intro.ios-share: On iPhone and iPad, install from the Share menu.
intro.firefox-android-menu: These steps are for {{browser}} on Android.
intro.mac-safari-dock: These steps are for {{browser}} on Mac.
intro.open-in-browser: Apps like WhatsApp or Instagram can’t install websites. Open HaqSe in your phone’s browser first.

chromium-menu: Tap the menu ⋮ at the top right. On a computer, click the install icon at the right of the address bar.
Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
Tap “Install”. HaqSe appears on your home screen.
ios-share: Tap the Share button (a square with an arrow). In Safari it is at the bottom; on iPad and in other browsers it is at the top.
Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
samsung-menu: Tap the menu ≡ at the bottom right.
mac-safari-dock: Click the “File” menu, or the Share button.
Click “Add”. HaqSe opens from your Dock like any app.
open-in-browser: Choose “Open in browser” (or “Open in Chrome” / “Open in Safari”).
In the browser, open HaqSe and tap “Install app”.
